title: San Mateo County Could Be First to Regulate Humanoid Robots for Commercial Use
snippet: Ken Goldberg, a robotics professor at UC Berkeley, said that while it's not a bad idea to start thinking about legislation, the humanoid workforce is still a long way off from being genuinely useful. Goldberg said that while people have been expecting humanoid robots since the '60s, engineers are still at least 10 years away — if not more — from creating robots that can do practical tasks.
